media.ext_alt_text: A traffic advisory from the Atlanta Department of Transportation. Temporary lane closures on Cascade Road Southwest.

The Atlanta Department of Transportation will temporarily shift traffic patterns along Cascade Road from Avon Avenue Southwest to Ralph David Abernathy Boulevard Southwest. 

Crews will intermittently close traffic lanes to accommodate resurfacing activities. Lanes will shift but will remain open to vehicular traffic for the duration of the closure.

This lane closure will begin on Sunday, June 8th, 2025 and will be in place 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. daily until resurfacing is complete.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY: The 3rd Annual Endurance Fest will be held at McCaughn Park, 402 South Shoreline Boulevard, with over 1,000 athletes participating. This three-day event is scheduled for this Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, June 6-8. 

Safety is a top priority, so motorists are reminded to be aware of the runners and cyclists, follow the posted detour signs, or seek alternate routes to avoid delays.

For details, visit https://t.co/cKiVWPjd7g.
